claim: Ceylon's transfer from Dutch to British rule was a product of the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars before 1815: British forces seized Dutch Ceylon in 1796, Amiens left it British in 1802, and the VOC had already disappeared by 1799.
notes: Do not date the Dutch withdrawal to the post-1815 settlement; 1815 matters as the end of the wider war cycle and the year of Kandyan annexation, not as the date of Dutch loss.
